Every pass reads and writes the same drawable. The Kaleidoscope (teal) can be placed at slot A, B or C.
fills background into drawable (mode 0/1 = original / matte)
if trails on: half-res snapshot capture
historical clone layers composited onto drawable
composites subject; folds gradient / video / liquid by order
runs when: explosions enabled AND i < index(.clapExplosions)
runs when: NOT before-explosions AND i < index(.lineSampler)
blit + per-line strip composite + occupancy read
runs when: NOT before-explosions AND NOT before-sampler (fallthrough)
Guard on every slot: kaleidoscopeEnabled AND displayMode ≥ Foreground (Original / Alpha Matte stay clean).
effectOrder = enabled effects, in stack order
disabled stages are skipped, not sentinels
Slot A / B → the Line Sampler captures
Slot C → the sampler captures the
folded image (lines feed on the fold).
The fold always covers subject, trails
and overlays — it cannot run beneath them.

One full-resolution compute pass (single sample per pixel) + one blit, only while enabled. Wedge count is free; cost scales with output resolution.
maps an output coordinate to the source pixel it reads
float wedge = TWO_PI / segments; // one wedge's angle
a = fmod(a, wedge); // fold into one wedge
a = a > wedge*0.5 ? wedge - a : a; // mirror ← symmetry
when a joint is chosen, so tracking runs even
